country.name: Eswatini
country.jurisdictionNotice: The Ministry of Education and Training, regional education offices, curriculum and examination bodies, ESHEC, ESQA and child-protection services have distinct responsibilities. School, TVET, higher-education and qualification claims must remain separate.
country.languagePolicy: siSwati and English are official languages with distinct instructional roles. Sign-language, inclusive-education and local cultural contexts require exact curriculum, learner stage, accessibility and community review; translation is not localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Liswati reviewer and current evidence from the competent ministry, regional office, NCC, examinations council, ESHEC, ESQA or institution.

governanceModel.summary: The education ministry and regional offices administer schools; the National Curriculum Centre develops curricula; the examinations council manages national assessment; ESHEC regulates post-secondary provision; ESQA has a distinct qualifications role.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve official institution name and identifier, region, tinkhundla or locality, stage, ownership, curriculum, authorization, current operation and census date. Census presence and examination participation are not current authorization.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Provisional authority, full registration, institutional accreditation, exact program accreditation, qualification registration, campus and award authority are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of Education and Training
authorities.role: general education, TVET and education policy and administration within its mandate

authorities.name: Regional education offices
authorities.role: territorial school administration, inspection and current school-record validation

authorities.name: National Curriculum Centre
authorities.role: curriculum design, preparation, coordination and evaluation

authorities.name: Examinations Council of Eswatini
authorities.role: national examination syllabuses, assessment and awards within its mandate

authorities.name: Education Management Information System
authorities.role: annual education census and sector reporting

authorities.name: Eswatini Higher Education Council
authorities.role: post-secondary institution registration, institutional and program accreditation and quality assurance

authorities.name: Eswatini Qualifications Authority
authorities.role: qualification-framework and qualification oversight within its mandate

authorities.name: Eswatini Data Protection Authority
authorities.role: personal-data regulation under the Data Protection Act 2022

curriculum.authority: National Curriculum Centre and competent Ministry authority
curriculum.title: National curricula and examination syllabuses by stage, grade, subject and cycle
curriculum.implementationRule: A curriculum-centre description, policy, examination syllabus, assessment specification, textbook or news announcement is not interchangeable with the controlling curriculum. Verify stage, grade, subject, language, approving authority, instrument, version and effective cycle.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: National curriculum, examination syllabus, assessment specification, textbook, teacher guide, foreign curriculum and external resource are separate layers.

schoolDirectory.authority: Ministry of Education and Training and responsible regional education office
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The 2024 Annual Education Census reports institutions and reporting rates but is not a current public school-authorization directory. Public web school lists and examination-centre lists do not prove current authorization, curriculum approval or operation. Verify each school through the responsible regional and ministry record.
requiredRecordFields: government, mission, community, private or other ownership
census date, source and review date

educationStatistics.scopeNotice: The National General Education Report 2024 reports census response rates and dated school, enrolment, staffing and outcome measures. Preserve census year, reporting rate, stage, region, ownership, definition and denominator. Counts must not be read as a live authorization directory.

vocationalQualifications.authority: Ministry, ESHEC and ESQA within their exact mandates
vocationalQualifications.authorityNotice: TVET provider registration, institutional accreditation, exact program accreditation, qualification-framework registration, assessment and award authority are separate claims. Verify provider, campus, program, qualification, level, decision and validity.

higherEducation.authorityNotice: The dated ESHEC list distinguishes provisional authority, full registration and accreditation and includes accredited programs. Institution status does not authorize every campus or program; verify exact institution category, campus, program, award, decision, conditions, validity and ESQA qualification status separately. Foreign and franchised programs require origin-country recognition where applicable.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionAuthority: Eswatini Data Protection Authority, designated through the Eswatini Communications Commission
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenFramework: Children’s Protection and Welfare Act No. 6 of 2012, Constitution section 29, applicable education protocols and National Plan of Action for Children 2023–2027
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Verify controller registration, DPO duties, lawful basis, consent, children’s and sensitive data, biometrics, transfers, retention, security, breach reporting and learner rights with EDPA. The statutory duty to report suspected abuse and current school case-management, referral, consent, inclusion and emergency procedures must be approved before a real learner pilot.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: siSwati, English, sign-language, inclusive-education and local cultural contexts have distinct instructional and accessibility roles. Preserve stage, terminology, orthography, curriculum authority and community review. Automatic translation is not localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Liswati education reviewer is named.
Ministry, regional, curriculum, examination, TVET, ESHEC, ESQA, privacy and child-protection responsibilities are verified.
A verified current public school authorization directory is documented or the gap remains visible.
Every statistic preserves census year, reporting rate, stage, region, ownership, definition and denominator.
Every curriculum record preserves stage, grade, subject, language, instrument, version and effective cycle.
Every post-secondary claim separately verifies institution category, campus, exact program, award, accreditation, qualification, conditions and validity.
EDPA compliance and current school child-safeguarding procedures are approved before a real learner pilot.
siSwati, English, sign-language and accessibility contexts remain distinct.
